notes.title: Patch Notes 12/20/2023
notes.content:
- Added an option to change the color of clouds
- Added a "fluffy" biome with grass on all sides
- Allowed terrain painting under the water

- Fixed a bug with cloud domain size shifting clouds upward
- Fixed a bug with incorrect control menu text labels

notes.title: Patch Notes 11/14/2023
notes.content:
This patch just provides fixes for a few minor bugs:
- Fixed screenshots being flipped vertically
- Fixed painting terrain when picking color for colorable biomes
- Fixed color selector being unable to select #FFFFFF
